% Pages of a PDF included with pdfpages, without hyperref: every page, a
% range, and \includepdfmerge with a range for each document. Each run
% starts with a paragraph "Run name." test-pdfpages has more forms.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pdfpages}
\begin{document}
Run dash.
\includepdf[pages=-]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run closed.
\includepdf[pages={2-3}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run merge.
\includepdfmerge{test-pdfpages/two,-,test-pdfpages/four,last}

Run end.
\end{document}
